release_notes:
1. Expanded search results detection to third-party themes and modules (Warehouse iqitsearch, Leo Search, Jolisearch, PM AdvancedSearch4).
2. Added multi-parameter search keyword extraction (s, search_query, q, query, tag).
3. Added client-side search discovery and third-party theme safety net in prestashop-adapter.js.
4. Verified 1-click update support and cleared Smarty caches.
